source.title: Victory Lap For the Goblins!
source.description:
Ha! I did it! uh, I mean...we did it!

That amateur Gnome consultant over there is throwing in the towel! He's paying us off to skip town! Why don't you do the honors eh? You earned it kid.
source.objective: Talk to Fizzbizz Coppercoil about getting a pay out.
source.completion: I have a proposal that I believe will be in both of our interests.
